metadata.limits: The tide of the open coast near the point, from a model cell up to 30 km away. Inside a bay, a harbour, an estuary, a lagoon or a sound the real tide can come an hour or more later and be higher or lower, and the model can be wrong there; the weather (surge) is not included. Measured: on the coasts of France the high and low waters came within 3 to 23 minutes (median) of the observed ones; in harbours and bays of the United States up to 2 h 22 early (docs/measurements/tides-2026-10.md).
metadata.disclaimer: Tide computed by Vigie from a global ocean tide model: not for navigation, and not an official tide table. Heights are relative to the mean sea level of the model, not to the chart datum of a port.
metadata.attribution: Tides computed by Vigie from the EOT20 ocean tide model (Hart-Davis et al. 2021, DGFI-TUM, SEANOE, https://doi.org/10.17882/79489), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); constants kept near the coasts and rounded by Vigie. Not for navigation
